How They Handle Restricted Countries

While some platforms have expanded their reach, many countries remain off-limits to popular payment processors like Stripe and PayPal. This is where COREMERCH shines, providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that operates independently of these platforms. With NOWPayments integrated into Edge Commerce Stack, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, enjoy 0.5% fees, and benefit from automated webhook functionality. This isn't a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that puts you in control of your shop's online presence and revenue.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed and fees, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack offers a unique advantage. With NOWPayments, you can enjoy transaction times under $0.10 per transaction, making it an attractive option for creators in restricted countries. COREMERCH's transparent pricing and fast transaction times give you a clear financial advantage.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery speed are critical factors in a creator's success. With COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, you maintain full ownership of your digital products, automating the payment and delivery process with NOWPayments. This means no more waiting for weeks for funds to clear, no more lost sales due to payment processor issues, and no more worrying about losing control of your shop's online presence. With Edge Commerce Stack, you're in the driver's seat, making it easier to focus on what matters most – creating value for your customers.
